text:
Sam (CSM): Quick flag  NorthCrest renewal in 5w. Usage for embeddings dropped ~75% over 14d and procurement flagged a competitor, VectorShift. Need triage.
Rae (AM): share the usage slice and any recent incidents?
Sam (CSM): telemetry: 14d tokens/day 20k -> 8k -> 5k; active seats 24 -> 15; top routes: /embeds 68%, /search 22%, /chat 10%; no sustained errors, small 502 blip last week.
Josh (Sales): VectorShift claims 40% lower $/1M embeds. Are they asking for on-prem or just price?
Elena (NorthCrest): Procurement looped new infra lead, Mateo. Primary asks: cost per 1M embeds with/without caching, latency at 50k QPS/day, and VPC/BYOK options. Finance put new annual spend on hold pending pilot.
Nora (Eng): We can run a 5-day dedicated pilot on a 2xA10 config to show caching impact and latency. BYOK for Private deploy needs extra setup (~10 business days). For pilot we can use test keys.
Rae (AM): propose: 5-day pilot (discounted), perf matrix + cache demo, 30-min tech readout with Eng, and a finance-facing one-pager. Legal ok?
Josh (Sales): recommend 25% pilot discount. @legal please confirm standard trial terms.
ops-bot: note created  renewal_watch:northcrest:1745000123 assigned:@Sam; reminder set 72h.
Sam (CSM): I'll schedule readout and send perf checklist to Mateo. Elena  can you confirm Mateo's target p95 and cost goal?
Elena (NorthCrest): Mateo's targets: p95 <120ms at our throughput, cost < $27 per 1M after caching. He also asked for a short written delta vs VectorShift on architecture (cache, batching, quant).
Nora (Eng): we'll produce a perf matrix: raw cost per 1M, cost with KV cache + 8-bit quant, p50/p95 latencies, and a small reproducible shell script for their infra team.
Rae (AM): I'll draft pilot commercial terms and loop Legal. Sam please own scheduling and the finance one-pager.
Sam (CSM): on it  will post invite + perf checklist here after sync with Mateo. :thumbsup:
Josh (Sales): agree on next steps. If pilot shows >=2.5x unit-cost improvement after caching we'll push for an accelerated approval.
ops-bot: reminder set for 72h follow-up on pilot readiness (automated).
